name: Team ProtoMan's Souls in BN6's engine
now: BN5's Souls 1-6, which Team Colonel's ROM holds whole but never gives (BN5_SOUL_FLAGS 0xFF), on BN6's proxy form as Team Colonel's six (src/emu/soulteam.h; docs/multirom/souls.md, Team ProtoMan's Souls; docs/rom/souls.md, their row): the differential opens one in BN5's own battle by its flag entry written in the guest's ROM copy (souls5); tools/xsoul.py walks their units after Team Colonel's into a room of their own (FREE_TEAM_SOULS), their power attacks at SOUL_POWER_TEAM (0xB1), past room for BN4's twelve. NapalmSoul and GyroSoul built and proved against BN5's battle: UNITE, look, element, charged shot (0x19, family 0x44 as 0xC8), chip charge doubled as the Napalm Bomb (0x0801043A, family 0x4B as 0xC9), lava step (0x080125FA), +40 to Fire chips (0x0800D0CE), Chaos Unison's power attack: soul_napalm, soul_napalm_shot, soul_napalm_charge, soul_napalm_lava PASS, their mutations FAIL. Every compare of the form with 1-6 in BN5's code is listed (docs/rom/souls.md). GyroSoul: his propeller (the companion overlay of BN5's kind 2 as BN6's 63), Air and Float shoes, tornado (0x09, family 0x3C as 0xCA), the propeller's rule (0x080102CA, 0x08010264) and spin: soul_gyro, soul_gyro_shot, soul_gyro_propeller PASS against BN5, soul_gyro_double held to BN5's course. MagnetSoul (5) moved too: his charged shot and B+Left, BN5's third-kind 0x75 and 0x3F with them (BN6's other bodies), his B+Left's misc family as the Souls' own copy (0xCC), his Elec chip charge doubled and the magnet panel's push spared (soul_magnet, _shot, _left, _charge, _panel PASS; _double held to BN5's course). ProtoSoul (1) too: his WideSword by the Souls' sword family, Reflect by the chips' Guard family, his Sword chip charge doubled and stepped in (soul_proto, _shot, _left, _charge PASS). SearchSoul's battle too (the scope gun, his ready's object): soul_search, _shot PASS. SearchSoul's SHUFFLE: BN6 kept BN5's button (0x0802A5D6, 0x080280E0), his Soul passes its test with three a turn (soulshuffle.c). MeddySoul's battle too (the capsule bomb): soul_meddy, _shot PASS.
left: MeddySoul (his capsules: BN5's Custom screen's Soul button, types 6 and 7, 0x08023CF4); NapalmSoul's Chaos Unison's spec; soul_napalm_charge's last frames (CanGard's fourth-kind object let go a frame apart at t321, not traced). Their emotion-window faces: none in Team Colonel's ROM (MegaMan's own shown).
